description: A test program for the tuxbox-framebuffer device that tests various display modes and pixel formats, including setting display modes, drawing test patterns, and manipulating color maps.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, sets up framebuffer, iterates over display modes and sizes, and performs drawing tests.

methods.name: setmode
methods.description: Configures the framebuffer to a specified pixel format and video size using ioctl calls.

methods.name: drawrect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with specified color and pixel format into the framebuffer memory.

methods.name: draw4field
methods.description: Creates a test pattern composed of four colored rectangles.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command-line options.

methods.name: col2pixel
methods.description: Converts a color into pixel data based on the pixel format.
